title: Observability-First Quickstart: Compact Traceboard & Cost-Latency Microshots
creator: Liam Patel
description: Create a compact, onboarding-friendly set of observability visuals ("Traceboard") that combines latency sparklines, per-token cost microcharts, and inline trace thumbnails for the Quickstart / first-run experience. The goal is a single compact tile UI that communicates performance and cost at a glance and allows users to expand for a focused trace view. This ticket covers design mocks, annotated export assets for engineering, accessible variants, and three responsive screenshot crops for docs and release notes.
tasks: Audit existing observability visuals and gather metrics & baseline screenshots
Design compact Traceboard tile (default, hovered, expanded) with emphasis on information density and scannability
Create PNG/SVG exports at 2x for docs (desktop wide, tablet narrow, mobile stacked)
Annotate interaction states and provide copy snippets for tooltips & microcopy
Run 5-session quick usability check with target PM/Eng users and incorporate feedback
Handoff assets and CSS spec to ENG runtime team; attach export manifest
deliverables: Figma file: Traceboard - compact & expanded frames
Annotated spec doc for engineering (component tokens, spacing, colors, A11Y contrast)
3 short copy variants for CTAs and hover states
Screen recording walkthrough (Loom) demonstrating hover->expand flow
acceptance_criteria: 1) Figma mock complete with desktop/tablet/mobile frames and explicit hover/expanded states; 2) PNG/SVG exports included and named in deliverables; 3) Engineering spec with tokenized spacing/colors and a11y contrast checks; 4) UX review sign-off from PM and ENG reviewer; 5) Usability notes with at least two actionable changes addressed
comments: 2026-03-03 - Marco Rivera (ENG): Reviewed initial sketches. Suggest reducing vertical height to fit two tiles per row in the onboarding grid. Also flagged potential cost-accuracy mismatch in token-rate computation. Added ENG-4521 to dependencies.

2026-03-06 - Ava Chen (DES): Iterated low-fidelity that collapses microtrace thumbnails into an overflow carousel when width < 680px. Uploaded new frames to Figma. Noted trade-off: loss of simultaneous multi-trace glance on mobile.

2026-03-09 - Priya Nair (PM): Approved copy variants; requested stronger CTA for "Investigate trace" that surfaces runbook link. Marked customer_impact as medium due to onboarding clarity improvements.
2026-03-12 - Design review: Accessibility pass done; adjusted color tokens to meet AA for small text; added alt text guidelines for exported PNGs.

2026-03-15 - Ava Chen (DES): Usability test summary added — 5 participants; top insight: users expected cost-per-token hover to show currency conversion and model variant. Follow-up: add small microcopy and link to cost explainer (PM requested).
